other_requirements.evidence: Please talk to me if you have not passed both courses with grades of C or better.

learning_outcomes: Students will learn and understand the concepts and applications of basic and advanced C++ topics including ADTs, pointer-based implementation of dynamic arrays and linked lists, operator overloading, STLs, inheritance, and polymorphism.
Students will learn the problem solving process and describe their solution to a computational problem in pseudocode.
Students will apply the above skills to develop medium sized C++ projects to solve real-world problems.

Students will learn to analyze the time complexity of foundational algorithms (recursive and non-recursive) such as binary search, insertion sort, selection sort, quick sort, and finding the k-th ranked object.

skills.evidence: More importantly, it teaches how to critically think about a problem, how to design an efficient and effective solution, and how to professionally implement your solution in C++.
